description: ⚠️ MANDATORY: Read mcp://resources/sop first. One call for a PAYMENT page whose final total is already visible (digital goods / SaaS): issues a JIT card and completes the payment. You MUST pass max_amount: the most, in US dollars, the owner agreed to pay for this — read the total on the page yourself, convert it to USD if the page is in another currency, and include tax/shipping. The card is never larger than max_amount. On a USD page Z-Zero also reads the visible total and stops (no card) if it is above max_amount or cannot be read. Card only: it never sends crypto to an address found on a page. For physical goods (Shopify, Etsy), use get_merchant_hints + request_payment_token + execute_payment instead.

checkout_url.description: Full URL of the checkout/payment page to pay.

max_amount.description: REQUIRED. The most the owner agreed to pay, in USD, all-in. For a page priced in another currency, convert to USD yourself (allow a little for exchange fees). The card is issued for at most this.

name: auto_pay_checkout
title: Auto-Pay Checkout (charges the card)
